documented_observed_mismatches.description: GET /api/settings response.config_registry.instance.config declares ~38 schema keys as the documented/possible set of instance-level config fields (with type/default/description/group/used_in metadata). The observed GET /api/instances?trashed response for instance 609 and 613 (APIOP-001 .config) contains only ~27 keys, and just ONE key name ('add_design_links') appears in both sets. Unresolved whether: (a) /api/instances returns only explicitly-set keys and unset schema defaults are omitted, (b) the two 'instance.config' references describe different underlying namespaces despite the shared label, or (c) the config_registry schema is stale/aspirational relative to what /api/instances actually serves.
